new: उन दोनों में लालिमायुक्त मूल कषाय और मधुर है, विपाक में कटु है, रूक्ष है और कफ तथा पित्त को हरने वाला है; फिर विशेष विधि से तैयार करने पर सब व्याधियों को शान्त करने वाला है; सुखपूर्वक विरेचन कराने के कारण शिशु, वृद्ध, सुकुमार और मृदु कोष्ठ वालों में प्रशस्त है; और वह 'त्रिवृत्' शब्द से कहा जाता है।
why: reviewer (minor): कल्पना in modern Hindi means imagination/fancy, so kalpanā-viśeṣāt (a particular manner of preparation) misleads the reader.

Either an instrumental (sarpirbhiḥ) is intended, or the list is one long instrumental compound running on through 'svādu-kvāthaiḥ' (… -svarasa-sarpiḥ-svādu-kvāthaiḥ), the printed space being a spacing slip. Grammar label and translation disagree; the printed form needs a note: either sarpirbhiḥ is intended, or sarpiḥ is the stem inside one long compound ending in svādu-kvāthaiḥ.

why: reviewer (minor): The Hindi drops ca ("and") at the start of the unit (cāṣṭapalonmitau begins with ca); English has "and".
reviewer (minor): aṣṭa-pala-unmita is "measured by eight palas" (instrumental tat-puruṣa on a dvigu), not a bahuvrīhi.

reviewer (minor): Member form should be the stem arśas, not the sandhi form arśaḥ. The note calls the visarga "the edition's spelling", but visarga before k is ordinary retained sandhi (arśas + kāmalā -> arśaḥkāmalā); nothing is wrong in the print.

why: reviewer (minor): Wrong explanation (see above): it is regular visarga sandhi before k.
